ActorTalk: Interrupting someone's thoughts is rude. And touching a projection is just pointless.
I thought this was just a recording.
I found this terminal while erasing leftover data... The moment I connected, I saw you reaching over.
I don't know what you were trying to do. But...
It's not a pleasant feeling, having someone's hand drift through you.
If you really want something, come find me in person next time.
(The terminal has returned to standby mode, its owner unknown. Alpha's connection appears to have been cut off.)
